entities.summary: Nichifor Crainic, also known by his nom de plume Ion Dobre, was a Romanian writer, editor, philosopher, poet and theologian famed for his traditionalist activities. Crainic was a professor of theology at the Bucharest Theological Seminary and the Chișinău Faculty of Theology. He was also a politician and ideologue associated with far-right, racist, fascist, and antisemitic positions. Nichifor Crainic was a philosophers & thinkers from Bulbucata (1889-12-22, Bulbucata–1972-08-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
